scope: Permitted 40-profile clean subset; 38 current keepers assessed and two leavers explicitly retained outside the current cohort.
decision_boundary: Evidence-led interview triage only; not a competence, eligibility or mobilisation determination.

method.work_evidence: An entry must contain an explicit maintenance action plus an electrical or mechanical plant term. Up to five diverse, highest-signal entries are shown; counts and hours are not treated as competence.
method.recommend_interview: At least three qualifying entries and either both electrical/mechanical coverage or explicit fault-finding evidence.
method.consider_interview: At least one qualifying entry but the stronger rule is not met.
method.training: Dated LearnHub outcome and supplied expiry are evaluated at the explicit cutoff. Pass, Attended and Not achieved remain distinct; expiry is never recomputed.
method.height_mapping: WAHS-1 is used as the supplied definition's direct height-safety module. This is a documented interpretation because the posting asks for a combined offshore certificate while OSSC itself has no height module.
